privacy.title: Development build and launch scope
privacy.body: This policy describes a development build preparing commercial v1. RevenueCat subscription and Google AdMob consent/banner adapters are included. Without store configuration, billing is unavailable in release builds and simulated with no charge in development. Native ads default to Google test units and load only after an explicit test-ad action. Live inventory requires the UMP privacy flow. These are not production integration acceptance. Final Privacy and Subscription Terms require review before launch.

privacy.title: Your practice data
privacy.body: IN/OUT stores your session history, self-reported tension ratings, optional reported effects, custom patterns, mixes, favorites and settings in the app's local storage. No account is required. State Shift is your own assessment, not a biometric or sensor measurement.

privacy.title: Collection and sharing
privacy.body: Practice history and tension ratings remain local and are not passed to advertising or analytics. With configured store keys, RevenueCat and the app stores process purchase, entitlement and app-user identifier information to provide subscriptions and restoration. When you review ad privacy choices and load a native test ad, Google consent/ad services receive the requests needed to provide those services. Production ad configuration is not enabled by default. The developer event logger accepts event names only, has no remote analytics sink and runs only in development. Audio and fonts are bundled. When you choose Share result, the shown text is passed to the service you select; that service receives the shared copy.

privacy.title: Device backups and security
privacy.body: Your phone's operating system may include app data in backups or device transfers, depending on your settings. Those copies are managed by your platform or backup provider. Data is stored within the app's sandbox; IN/OUT does not provide separate database encryption or cloud recovery. Anyone with access to your unlocked phone may be able to open your history.

privacy.title: Retention and deletion
privacy.body: Local data stays in the app until you delete it or remove the app's data. Delete individual sessions in History and individual routines in your saved library. Settings includes Delete local history and Delete all local data. Deletion in IN/OUT does not remove copies you previously shared or copies held in device backups. Manage those through their respective services.

privacy.title: Support and platform services
privacy.body: If you contact support, we receive what you choose to send, such as your email address and issue description. Do not include medical information or tension ratings unless necessary for your request. Support correspondence is used to respond to you and resolve the issue, and retained only as needed for that purpose or applicable obligations. App stores and operating systems may separately process installation, download, or diagnostic information under their own policies.

privacy.title: Permissions and changes
privacy.body: This release does not request microphone, camera, location, contacts or health-sensor access. Optional audio, vibration and screen-awake behavior are controlled in Settings. We will update this policy when our data practices change and identify the effective date here.

privacy.title: Public privacy and support website
privacy.body: The public privacy and support pages are hosted on GitHub Pages. Opening them sends ordinary web requests, which may include your IP address and browser information, to that hosting provider. These pages use no IN/OUT analytics, cookies or advertising. The privacy and help text bundled inside the app can be read offline without opening the website.

safety.title: Wellbeing, not medical care
safety.body: IN/OUT is a breathing practice tool, not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any medical condition. Results are not guaranteed. Ask a qualified healthcare professional if you have concerns about whether a breathing practice is appropriate for you.

safety.title: Keep it comfortable
safety.body: Practice seated or lying somewhere safe. Breathe gently without forcing depth or speed. Holds are optional: return to natural breathing whenever you need to. The timer is a guide, not a target to push through.

safety.title: Stop when you need to
safety.body: If you feel dizzy, faint or unwell, use I feel unwell to pause the guide immediately, then end the session and breathe naturally. Seek medical help for severe or persistent symptoms. The app is not an emergency service.

safety.title: Choose a safe place
safety.body: Do not follow breathing exercises while driving, operating machinery, swimming, bathing, or in or near water. Do not use breath holds as a competition. High-intensity cyclic breathing is not included in this release.

support.title: My session paused
support.body: App switching, screen lock and supported audio interruptions pause the guide. Return to the session and choose Resume, Restart or End session. After a forced closure, the app recovers the last saved checkpoint and waits for you to resume.

support.title: I cannot hear guidance
support.body: Choose Sound cues or Concise voice in Settings. Check your phone volume, headphones and the iPhone silent switch. Audio follows the silent switch. Haptics may be limited by your device or system settings.

support.title: Can I use IN/OUT offline?
support.body: Yes. Protocols, custom routines, sessions, State Shift and history work without a network connection. Sharing through another service and contacting support may require internet access.

support.title: Where are my routines?
support.body: Open Custom, then Saved Presets or Saved Mixes. Use Save routine in the editor to keep a routine on this phone. Editing or deleting a saved routine does not change previous sessions.

support.title: Moving phones or deleting data
support.body: This release has no IN/OUT account or cloud sync. Device backup and transfer behavior depends on your operating system. Removing app data may permanently remove your history and routines. Delete all local data in Settings resets the app, including an interrupted session.

support.title: Pro, restore and test advertising
support.body: Open Settings, then Pro & subscriptions. Development demo purchases are clearly labeled and do not charge money. In a configured native build, purchase and restoration use your App Store or Google Play account. Deleting local practice data does not cancel a store subscription. Manage cancellation in the store. Native banners default to Google test units; Expo Go cannot display the native ad SDK. Core protocols remain available without a purchase.
